name: @activepieces/piece-sftp
description: Connect to FTP, FTPS or SFTP servers

allow_unauthorized_certificates.description: Allow connections to servers with self-signed certificates

allow_anonymous_login.description: Allow anonymous login to FTP servers (only applicable for FTP/FTPS)

password.description: The password to authenticate with. Either this or private key is required. When using a private key, this field is used as the passphrase to decrypt the key.

privateKey.description: The private key to authenticate with. Either this or password is required.

algorithm.description: The host key algorithm to use for SFTP connection. Only needed if you want to override the default algorithms (e.g., to support ssh-dss).

create_file.name: create_file
create_file.description: Create a new file in the given path

upload_file.name: upload_file
upload_file.description: Upload a file to the given path.

fileName.description: The path on the sftp server to store the file. e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`

read_file_content.name: read_file_content
read_file_content.description: Read the content of a file.

deleteFile.name: deleteFile
deleteFile.description: Deletes a file at given path.

filePath.description: The path of the file to delete e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`

createFolder.name: createFolder
createFolder.description: Creates a folder at given path.

folderPath.description: The new folder path e.g. `./myfolder`. For FTP/FTPS, it will create nested folders if necessary.

recursive.description: For SFTP only: Create parent directories if they do not exist

deleteFolder.name: deleteFolder
deleteFolder.description: Deletes an existing folder at given path.

folderPath.description: The path of the folder to delete e.g. `./myfolder`

recursive.description: Enable this option to delete the folder and all its contents, including subfolders and files.

listFolderContents.name: listFolderContents
listFolderContents.description: Lists the contents of a given folder.

directoryPath.description: The path of the folder to list e.g. `./myfolder`

renameFileOrFolder.name: renameFileOrFolder
renameFileOrFolder.description: Renames a file or folder at given path.

information.description: Depending on the server you can also use this to move a file to another directory, as long as the directory exists.

oldPath.description: The path of the file or folder to rename e.g. `./myfolder/test.mp3`

newPath.description: The new path of the file or folder e.g. `./myfolder/new-name.mp3`

new_file.name: new_file
new_file.description: Trigger when a new file is created or modified.

path.description: The path to watch for new files

nl.Connect to FTP, FTPS or SFTP servers: Verbinding maken met FTP, FTPS of SFTP-servers
nl.Allow connections to servers with self-s: Verbindingen met servers met zelfondertekende certificaten toestaan
nl.Allow anonymous login to FTP servers (on: Anonieme inloggen op FTP-servers toestaan (alleen van toepassing op FTP/FTPS)
nl.The username to authenticate with: De gebruikersnaam om mee te verifiëren
nl.The password to authenticate with. Eithe: Het wachtwoord om mee te verifiëren. Of deze of private key is vereist. Wanneer u een private key gebruikt, wordt dit veld gebruikt als wachtwoordzin om de sleutel te decoderen.
nl.The private key to authenticate with. Ei: De geheime sleutel om mee te verifiëren. Of dit of het wachtwoord is vereist.
nl.The host key algorithm to use for SFTP c: Het host-sleutel-algoritme dat gebruikt moet worden voor SFTP-verbinding. Alleen nodig als u de standaard algoritmes wilt overschrijven (bijv. om ssh-dss) te ondersteunen.

Maakt een map aan op het opgegeven pad.
nl.Deletes an existing folder at given path: Verwijdert een bestaande map van het opgegeven pad.

nl.The path on the sftp server to store the: Het pad op de sftp server om het bestand op te slaan. b.v. `./mijnmap/test.mp3`
nl.The path of the file to delete e.g. `./m: Het pad van het bestand om te verwijderen, bijv. `./myfolder/test.mp3`
nl.The new folder path e.g. `./myfolder`. F: Het nieuwe mappad bijv. `./myfolder`. Voor FTP/FTPS, zal het geneste mappen aanmaken indien nodig.

nl.The path of the folder to list e.g. `./m: Het pad van de map om bijv. `./myfolder` te tonen
